## How I tested it

- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] Tried it in the browser (say which mode: `npm run real`, `npm start`, or the file demo)

## Checklist

- [ ] Every new animation or movement on the map comes from a real event, not decoration
- [ ] Anything that writes outside `workspace/drafts`, spends money or reaches the outside world still asks the player first
- [ ] No API keys, tokens or personal data in code, tests, screenshots or logs
- [ ] All art, names and creatures are original
- [ ] README or `docs/EVENTS.md` updated if behaviour or the event API changed
